coverageNote.note: Barnes & Noble has ~600 US stores fed by ~6 regional DCs; we mapped the DC network (the only sites where trailer ops matter).

sites.name: Barnes & Noble - Monroe Township NJ DC

steps.step: Arrive at gate (no guard, kiosk or call box)

sites.dossierExcerpt:
The roster pin (40.358049, -74.464912, geocoded ROOFTOP) landed directly on the
roof of a very large single-building distribution center in the Docks Corner /
Cranbury-Monroe industrial submarket, alongside the NJ Turnpike and Route 33.
Web search confirmed "Barnes & Noble Distribution, 1 Barnes & Noble Way, Monroe
Township NJ 08831" at this location (Yellowpages, Chamber of Commerce, Waze,
Loc8NearMe). The building footprint derived from the perimeter geofence works
out to ~73.5 acres, matching the dossier's stated 73-acre footprint and ~1.15M
sq ft building — a strong independent corroboration. Location locked at the
building centroid 40.35820, -74.46510.

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 1 Barnes & Noble Way, Monroe Township NJ. Single ~1.15M sq ft DC building; derived site area 73.5 acres matches dossier's stated 73 acres, strongly corroborating the building identification.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully chain-link fenced (fence confirmed via Street View on the west side and visible in satellite along the south). The dock yard is a secured enclosure and the truck route necessarily passes a fence line, implying a controlled gate. No barrier-arm or sliding-gate STRUCTURE was directly captured in available imagery (Street View covers only public roads and the east perimeter loop, not the truck-yard entrance), so this is a medium-confidence inference from the fenced perimeter.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth found anywhere on the property in satellite (z18-z21) or Street View. The structure cluster at the SE corner is a fenced utility/electrical equipment yard with transformers and storage containers, not a check-in booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the basis of truckGate=true with no guard booth; check-in is likely kiosk/app-based. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous bank of loading doors spans the entire south face of the building with many trailers backed in; clearly 50+ band. Dossier states 115 doors; overhead count estimate ~110.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking stalls full of dropped trailers at the SW corner and along the SE south edge; estimated 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows at the SW and SE corners separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron south of the dock face provides interior queuing/staging room; inferred true.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal perimeter route from the public-road entrance, around the east and south of the building to the docks, easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Large modern industrial park (Docks Corner / Cranbury-Monroe submarket) adjacent to NJ Turnpike and Route 33, dense suburban-NJ industrial fabric; Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs E-W south of the property but lies in a separate corridor outside the perimeter fence with no spur entering the site; not rail-served.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Not separately determinable; entrance shared with employee traffic. Estimated 1 in / 1 out, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approx 55 trailers counted at docks and in drop areas in the captured imagery; honest overhead estimate.

sites.name: Barnes & Noble - Reno NV DC

steps.step: Arrive at gate (no guard, kiosk or call box)

sites.dossierExcerpt:
The roster pin (39.418826, -119.750481, geocoded ROOFTOP) landed directly on a
large white-roofed distribution warehouse in the Damonte Ranch industrial park
in south Reno, alongside Interstate 580 / US-395. Web search confirmed "Barnes
& Noble Distribution Center, 12660 Old Virginia Rd, Reno NV 89521" at this
location — the West Coast replenishment / e-commerce hub (Panjiva buyer report,
Reno-Sparks Chamber of Commerce, Barnes & Noble Reno Distribution Center
Facebook page; lease renewed Nov 2025 per the roster source). Single ~601K sq
ft building. Location locked at the building centroid 39.41870, -119.75050.

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 12660 Old Virginia Rd, Reno NV 89521 in the Damonte Ranch industrial park, alongside I-580/US-395. Single ~601K sq ft DC building. Address verified via Panjiva, Chamber of Commerce, and Facebook (Barnes & Noble Reno Distribution Center).
fieldNotes.truckGate: CONFIRMED via Street View (2022 and 2025 panos): a yellow-and-white striped barrier arm spans the entrance driveway lane, flanked by yellow protective bollards, with a STOP sign. The 2015 pano shows the same driveway WITHOUT the arm, so the barrier was installed after 2015. High confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere at the entrance in any Street View pano (2015/2022/2025) or satellite imagery. The barrier arm stands alone with no adjacent staffed structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Barrier-arm truck gate with no guard booth implies badge/card or remote/app check-in; remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous bank of loading-dock doors along the SOUTH building face; roughly 20+ trailers visible backed in. Roof glare in satellite limits an exact count; estimated ~38 doors, 25-50 band. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A row of trailer parking south of the dock apron holds dropped trailers; estimated 10-25 band. Not a large dedicated drop lot, so dropYard flag left false.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Long paved driveway approach between the public road and the barrier arm provides room for trucks to wait before the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide dock apron inside the gate before the dock doors provides interior staging room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gate-to-dock approach plus the wide apron easily holds a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Damonte Ranch is a master-planned suburban district of south Reno with dense surrounding development - apartment complexes immediately north, multiple warehouses adjacent, and the I-580 freeway. Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Several large warehouses surround the site but they are separate properties; the B&N facility is a single building.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the nearest rail is not adjacent. Not rail-served.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared entrance driveway with the barrier arm; estimated 1 in / 1 out, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approx 22 trailers counted at the south docks and in the trailer-parking row; honest overhead estimate.
